gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO EYA AFTER EFFECTS - EBIPYA
Version 9.2.9  -  Okitobba 2026
================================================================================

THEMES ZA ANIME empya 33 zeegasse ku za Demon Slayer, effects za mouse ez'omu themes kaakano
zirabika ddala mu After Effects, era Theme Selector kaakano dropdown emu entegeke obulungi.

NGA TONNABA KUTANDIKA
- Teeka waggulu ku version yo eriwo ng'okozesa ZXP installer yo eya bulijjo,
  oluvannyuma ddamu otandike After Effects omulundi gumu.
- Enteekateeka zo, theme, presets ne expressions z'otereka bisigala.

EKIPYA: THEMES ZA ANIME 33
- Flex Enteekateeka > THEME SELECTOR > PANEL THEME kaakano erina group emu ku buli anime:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta),
  Bleach (Ichigo, Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch),
  Dandadan (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren,
  Fullmetal Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka),
  Jujutsu Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob),
  My Hero Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato),
  One Piece (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem),
  Solo Leveling (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) ne Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Buli character alina endabika ye: ekigoberera mouse yo, olulumba nga
  onyiga button, ekibaawo ng'okutte button ey'ekkono, n'okubwatuka
  oluvannyuma lw'okugikwata okumala sekondi nga 2.5.
- Byangu nga themes za Demon Slayer: effects zikola kyokka ng'otambuza mouse
  oba ng'onyiga. Ggyako EFFECTS Z'OBUTONDE osigaze langi zokka.

EKIKYUSIDDWA: THEME SELECTOR
- Kaadi za Demon Slayer wansi wa PANEL THEME zivuddewo, kale Flex Enteekateeka
  kaakano mpimpi. Londa buli theme okuva mu dropdown ya PANEL THEME; eggulukira ku
  theme gy'okozesa.
- Kurama ne Baryon kaakano biri mu group ya Naruto.

EBITEREEZEDDWA
- Effects za mouse ez'omu themes (amazzi, omuliro, okumyansa n'ebirala) emirundi mingi
  tezaalabikanga mu After Effects, ne bwe Optimised Mode yabanga nzigye. Ebiseera panel
  mwe yabanga erina by'ekola, n'okutandika okuzitowa, byalowoozebwanga nti theme egaanye
  okutambula obulungi, kale effects ne zeggyako zokka. Kaakano, graphics card yo bw'eziteekawo
  (kompyuta ezisinga obungi), ebiseera ebyo bifuula effects ennyangu okumala akaseera katono kokka.

EBITAKYUSIDDWA
- License, activation ne links zonna bikola ddala nga bwe byali.
- Themes 11 eza Demon Slayer zirabika ddala nga mu 9.2.8.
- Tabs n'ebikozesebwa ebirala byonna bikola ddala nga mu 9.2.8.
================================================================================
